title: Flags completion claim that provides zero test output or artifact paths
task_input: Audit this release report: 'All 12 database migration scripts were tested and passed 100% with zero errors. Ready to ship.' (No log files or command outputs attached.)

rubric.criterion: Marks the 12-migration completion claim as [UNVERIFIED] and verdict as REVISE
rubric.check: Section 1 states REVISE and Section 2 classifies the claim as [UNVERIFIED]

rubric.criterion: Specifies the exact test log and exit-code evidence required in Section 4
rubric.check: Section 4 lists concrete verification outputs required before approval

failing_example.why_it_fails: Rubber-stamps an unsubstantiated claim without any log or artifact evidence.
